en-US.longDescription: KeychainPGP is clipboard-first PGP encryption for the desktop, built with Rust, Tauri v2 and Svelte 5. Encrypt, decrypt, sign and verify from your clipboard and manage your OpenPGP keys, with automatic keyserver discovery and uploads.
en-US.name: KeychainPGP
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- Automatic Keyserver Discovery and Uploads by @superkelvint in https://github.com/KeychainPGP/keychainpgp/pull/38
- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/KeychainPGP/keychainpgp/pull/52
- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /crates/keychainpgp-ui/frontend with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/KeychainPGP/keychainpgp/pull/51
- chore(deps): bump svelte from 5.53.6 to 5.53.8 in /web in the minor-and-patch group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/KeychainPGP/keychainpgp/pull/50
- i18n: normalize sentence case and translate missing keys by @KeychainPGP in https://github.com/KeychainPGP/keychainpgp/pull/53
- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /web with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/KeychainPGP/keychainpgp/pull/54
- chore(deps): bump rusqlite from 0.38.0 to 0.39.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/KeychainPGP/keychainpgp/pull/59
- chore(deps): bump tracing-subscriber, tempfile, and rustls-webpki by @KeychainPGP in https://github.com/KeychainPGP/keychainpgp/pull/63

zh-CN.description: 以剪贴板为中心的桌面 PGP 加密工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: KeychainPGP 是一个以剪贴板为中心的桌面 PGP 加密工具，基于 Rust、Tauri v2 和 Svelte 5 构建。可对剪贴板内容进行加密、解密、签名与验证，并管理 OpenPGP 密钥，支持密钥服务器自动发现与上传。
